# Upstream

- Project: `dex-retargeting`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/dexsuite/dex-retargeting>
- Vendored package version: `0.5.0`
- License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE`

Only the runtime package under `src/dex_retargeting` is vendored here. DexRoam
keeps its XHand-specific configuration and robot assets outside the upstream
snapshot.
